definitions.Delta_c: for alive subcomponent c of matrix k (rank-1 u_c v_c^T): mean over the task's TRAINING windows, at the trigger, of |(x1 - x0) . v_c| * ||u_c||, x1 = k's input in the fine-tuned model's pass, x0 = in W0's pass
definitions.restore X, rho_r(X): as Amendment 3 (predictions_amend3.json), on the held-out windows
definitions.C_n: per layer, the |S in that layer| alive pieces not in S with the largest Delta_c (ties: matrix name, then index); the whole layer's non-S alive pieces if fewer (recorded)
definitions.C_m: per layer, alive pieces not in S in descending Delta_c (same ties) until their summed Delta_c >= S's summed Delta_c in that layer; empty where S has no members or S's sum is 0; the whole layer if never reached (recorded as short)
definitions.L3, rest, singles, random singles (emoti: L3 = alive pieces in layer 3 not in S with task.m0 >= 0.2 (Amendment 3's pool); rest = recruitment.active_like(S, that state's pool at 0.2, 0) minus its layer-3 members; singles = each L3 member restored alone; random singles = |L3| single pieces drawn with seed 0 from layer 3's alive pieces not in S with task.m0 < 0.2
